answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 120 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a wharf bet on surviving 120 epochs of grading, and every summit settlement recomputes the ferrous schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
